entities.title: The workflow
entities.summary: The GitHub Actions workflow that tests every pull request and deploys main to cyberspace-explorer.com.
entities.purpose: Keeps what runs at cyberspace-explorer.com the same as main, tested first.
boundaries: The Worker's own secrets are set once on Cloudflare; a deploy does not touch them.
Branch protection and the production environment's reviewers are repository settings, not files here.
